definition.name: Sealed normal Java compiler product (data only)

steps.name: Install the maintained recipe reader dependencies
Verify fixed compiler inputs, existing pack and installer, and normal admission
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
root=$(mktemp -d /tmp/latent-java-product.XXXXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$root"' EXIT
mkdir -p target/java-compiler-product
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5 1195 \
  python -B tools/java_guest/compiler_profile_distribution.py stage \
    --root "$root" \
    --output target/java-compiler-product/result.json

reviewReason: Use explicit conventional prepared Java compiler CLI with committed owner fingerprint; all selected product and existing job semantics remain reviewed.
